# Voidix

> A free, non-commercial Minecraft server community in China.

Voidix provides minigame and survival servers. Java and Bedrock players can connect to the network.

## Official pages

- https://www.voidix.net/ - Server overview and connection guide
- https://www.voidix.net/status/ - Current server status
- https://www.voidix.net/faq/ - Frequently asked questions
- https://www.voidix.net/bug-report/ - Feedback channels
- https://www.voidix.net/privacy/ - Privacy policy

## Server addresses

- Minigame: `minigame.voidix.net`
- Survival: `survival.voidix.net`
